summary: End-to-end testing of AutoSolutions.in MVP completed. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (health, stats/public, leads CRUD with validation 422, no _id leak, recency sort). Frontend: hero 3D Three.js canvas rendered, all 5 navbar testids present, pricing monthly/yearly toggle correctly switches Starter from ₹4,999 to ₹3,999 and back, testimonial dots swap card content, FAQ accordion expands (data-state closed -> open), contact form successfully creates a lead and shows success message, empty form is blocked by HTML5 required validation. 0 console errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero CTA testids in code are 'hero-get-started-btn' / 'hero-watch-demo-btn' while the review request mentioned 'hero-cta-get-started' / 'hero-cta-watch-demo'. Buttons render & function correctly; this is only a naming inconsistency to be aware of.
Calendly link (calendly.com/demo) and WhatsApp link (wa.me/919999999999) are intentional placeholder hrefs per spec — not bugs.
Backend uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers for future-proofing (non-blocking).
Lead model stores created_at then immediately serializes to ISO string in insert and re-parses on list — works, but a Mongo-native datetime would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed lead documents in Mongo via POST /api/leads during pytest and a TEST_PWUser lead via Playwright contact form flow. Safe to leave or purge; none collide with real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (11 tests, all green). Public URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://bot-solutions-india.preview.emergentagent.com. For Playwright, always destroy Lenis (window.__lenis?.destroy()) and use scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant'}). Hero headline uses TextScramble effect so a static text match for 'We Automate. You Grow.' may fail mid-animation — prefer testid 'hero-headline-1' / 'hero-headline-2'. Hero CTA testids are 'hero-get-started-btn' and 'hero-watch-demo-btn'.
